name: Boredom Movement Mode
description: Supplies a physical activation stimulus to Boredom Autonomy, which authors the purpose, selects from the advertised catalog, and revises its intention after feedback.

properties.message: Use movement as the first consequence of a self-directed boredom episode. Boredom Autonomy authors the intent and must choose exactly one safe robotCommand from the connected robot's complete advertised command catalog. This trigger has no preferred command or movement category. Do not combine commands or invent body parts. Preserve the self-authored intent, review the correlated result, and decide the next consequence from updated evidence.
